name: Derwent London Plc
summary: Derwent London Plc owns a commercial real estate portfolio predominantly in central London valued at 5.0 billion pounds as at 30 June 2026, making it the largest London office-focused real estate investment trust (REIT). Their experienced team has a long track record of creating value throughout the property cycle by regenerating buildings via redevelopment or refurbishment, effective asset management and capital recycling. The firm typically acquires central London properties off market with low capital values and modest rents in improving locations, most of which are either in the West End or City Borders.
